package.name: easyfleet_core
package.description: C++ library that wraps rclcpp_action to provide a clean, inheritance-based action server base class and a comfortable action client wrapper, including parameter-driven control of whether an action can be preempted. Also provides the Capability lifecycle-node base class every EasyFleet capability builds on, plus the per-domain NavigationActionServerBase / ManipulationActionServerBase / PerceptionActionServerBase classes that fix the action type for concrete backend implementations (Nav2, EasyNav, a fake mock, ...) living in their own packages.
